title: Pure Super Quant
summary: Pure Super Quant sentai strategy centered on Super Quantum Layers piloting matching Mech Beast Xyz Monsters under the command of Super Quantal Mech Ship Magnacarrier. Attaching the corresponding Layer unlocks Quick Effect disruptions, culminating in the nearly invincible multi-material titan Super Quantal Mech King Great Magnus.

summary.title: Starters
points: Super Quantum Blue Layer adds any Super Quant card from your Deck to your hand when Normal or Special Summoned, and recycles up to 3 Super Quant cards from GY to Deck when sent to the GY.
Super Quantal Fairy Zetan Special Summons itself from hand while you control a Super Quant monster, and tributes itself to Special Summon any Super Quant monster directly from your Deck.
Super Quantum Red Layer Special Summons itself from hand while you control no monsters, adds a Super Quant card from GY to hand on summon, and revives a Super Quant when sent to the GY.
Super Quantum Green Layer Special Summons a Super Quant monster from your hand on summon, and discards a Super Quant card to draw 1 card when sent to the GY.
Super Quantal Mech Ship Magnacarrier discards 1 card to rank up a Super Quantum Layer into its matching Mech Beast Xyz Monster using only that monster as material.

summary.title: Opening: Blue Layer + Magnacarrier
steps: Normal Summon Super Quantum Blue Layer and activate its effect to search Super Quantal Mech Ship Magnacarrier.
Activate Super Quantal Mech Ship Magnacarrier, then discard a card to target Blue Layer and Xyz Summon Super Quantal Mech Beast Grampulse with Blue Layer attached.
Special Summon Super Quantal Fairy Zetan, tributing it to summon Super Quantum Red Layer or Green Layer from your Deck.
Use Magnacarrier's effect to overlay each Layer into its matching Mech Beast, unlocking their Quick Effects.
Send Magnacarrier to the GY to combine 3 or more different Mech Beasts into Super Quantal Mech King Great Magnus.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Super Quantal Mech King Great Magnus shuffles a card on the field into the Deck as a Quick Effect with 2+ materials, becomes completely unaffected by card effects with 4+ materials, and prevents the opponent from adding cards from Deck to hand with 6+ materials.
Super Quantal Mech Beast Magnaliger detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect with Red Layer to destroy 1 monster on the field.
Super Quantal Mech Beast Aeroboros detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect with Green Layer to flip a face-up monster face-down.
Super Quantal Mech Beast Grampulse detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect with Blue Layer to destroy 1 Spell or Trap on the field.
Super Quantal Mech Beast Lusterrex detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect with White Layer to negate the effects of 1 effect monster on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Super Quantal Mech Ship Magnacarrier allows any Super Quantum Layer to cheat out its matching Mech Beast, and sends itself to the GY to combine your Mech Beasts into Great Magnus.
Super Quantal Alphan Spike shuffles all cards your opponent controls into the Deck when you control 3 or more Super Quantum monsters with different names.
Super Quantal Alphancall Appeal Special Summons a Super Quantal Mech Beast and attaches a Layer from your GY when a Super Quant monster is destroyed by battle.
Super Quantal Union - Magnaformation protects your Super Quant cards from opponent targeting during Main Phase 1 and attaches materials to your Xyz Monsters.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Layer 19: Preventing the Invasion! The Pitch-Black Super Quantum!! is not yet released in the TCG and is excluded from this build.
